description: Implement the custom Solana on-chain vault program using Anchor framework. This program manages user vaults for non-custodial automated trading. Users deposit funds, set risk parameters enforced on-chain, and the execution service can trade within those limits without per-trade wallet signatures.
steps: Create programs/ directory structure with Anchor project layout: programs/vault/Cargo.toml, programs/vault/Xargo.toml, programs/vault/src/lib.rs
Create Anchor.toml at project root with program ID placeholder, cluster config, and test script

Implement the vault program in programs/vault/src/lib.rs with these instructions: initialize_vault (creates PDA vault account for user, sets authority), deposit (transfers SOL from user to vault PDA), withdraw (transfers SOL from vault PDA back to authority), update_risk_params (authority-only: set max_trade_size, max_daily_loss, max_slippage_bps, max_open_positions, allowed_dexs, token_blacklist), pause_vault (authority-only: sets is_paused flag), resume_vault (authority-only: clears is_paused flag), execute_trade (called by authorized executor: validates all risk params on-chain before allowing CPI to DEX program, enforces max_trade_size, checks daily_loss_counter, verifies token not blacklisted, verifies DEX is allowed, checks is_paused)

Define account structures: VaultAccount (authority pubkey, executor pubkey, deposited_sol u64, available_sol u64, max_trade_size u64, max_daily_loss u64, max_slippage_bps u16, max_open_positions u8, daily_loss_counter u64, daily_loss_reset_slot u64, is_paused bool, bump u8), VaultConfig (allowed_dexs Vec<Pubkey>, token_blacklist Vec<Pubkey>)
Implement proper PDA derivation: vault PDA seeded by [b'vault', user_pubkey], config PDA seeded by [b'vault_config', vault_pubkey]

Add comprehensive error codes: VaultPaused, UnauthorizedExecutor, MaxTradeSizeExceeded, DailyLossLimitReached, SlippageExceeded, MaxOpenPositionsReached, DexNotAllowed, TokenBlacklisted, InsufficientVaultBalance, InvalidAuthority

Create programs/vault/tests/vault.ts with Anchor test cases covering: vault creation, deposit, withdrawal, risk param updates, pause/resume, execute_trade success, execute_trade rejection for each risk violation

Create a TypeScript SDK wrapper in packages/vault-sdk/src/index.ts that provides typed methods for interacting with the vault program from the backend services (createVault, deposit, withdraw, updateRiskParams, pauseVault, resumeVault, buildExecuteTradeInstruction)
acceptance_criteria: Anchor program compiles without errors (anchor build)
TypeScript SDK builds successfully and exports all vault interaction methods
Vault PDA derivation is deterministic and correct
All risk parameters are enforced in the execute_trade instruction
Program includes comprehensive error codes for each failure mode
Test file covers happy path and all rejection scenarios
verification: Verify Anchor program Rust code compiles by checking syntax (anchor build requires Solana toolchain which may not be available - verify Rust syntax is correct)
findings: Anchor build requires Solana BPF toolchain (not available in sandbox). Rust code is syntactically correct Anchor code but cannot be compiled here. TypeScript SDK builds and all 20 tests pass. The full monorepo build (13 packages) and test suite (117 tests across all packages) pass successfully. pnpm-lock.yaml updated with @coral-xyz/anchor and @solana/web3.js dependencies for vault-sdk.
